home.title: Confidence Trivia
home.tagline: Knowing the answer is only half the game.

rules.title: How to Play
rules.intro: Everything you need to answer, compete, earn, and play with friends.

loop.title: Each round
loop.body: Answer before time runs out, choose confidence, place an optional side bet, then see the result. When everyone finishes a step, its timer drops to 3 seconds.

questions.title: Question types
questions.body: Rounds can use multiple choice, true or false, written answers, ordering, estimates, or closest-answer questions. Closest Answer ranks guesses by distance from the result.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.body: Choose your risk after answering: None +0/-0, 1 gives +1/-1, 3 gives +2/-2, 5 gives +3/-4, and 6 gives +4/-5.

sideBets.title: Side bets
sideBets.body: Optionally predict whether another player's answer is correct or wrong. A right prediction gives +1 point and a wrong one gives -1. You can change or remove it before it locks.

classic.title: Classic
classic.body: Correct Easy, Medium, and Hard questions are worth 1, 2, and 3 points before confidence is applied. The player with the highest score after the final round wins.

damage.title: 1v1 Damage
damage.body: Correct answers damage your opponent. If both players are correct, no hit occurs and the damage pot grows for the next decisive round. Reduce the opponent to 0 HP to win.

ranked.title: Ranked
ranked.body: Four players compete over 10 rounds. LP depends only on final place: 1st +30, 2nd +15, 3rd +0, 4th -15. Your first 3 matches determine your starting rank.

stars.title: Stars and wagers
stars.body: Stars are account currency, separate from match points. In 1v1, both players stake the selected wager and the winner receives the full pot; a drawn game refunds both stakes.

dailyRewards.title: Earning stars
dailyRewards.body: Your first 5 eligible completed games each day award 10 stars. Claim the daily reward to build a 5-day streak worth 10, 20, 30, 50, then 75 stars.

cosmetics.title: Shop and inventory
cosmetics.body: Spend stars on name colors, avatars, and solid or animated frames. Owned items stay in your inventory, and your equipped look appears in rooms and results.

accounts.title: Accounts and guests
accounts.body: Guests can play unranked games. Sign in to keep account progress and unlock Ranked, Friends, the Shop, and Inventory. Account names must be unique.

friends.title: Friends
friends.body: Add up to 25 friends. Bless each friend once per UTC day; each claimed blessing gives them 2 stars. Online friends can be challenged to a wagered 1v1 match.
